ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for residential, undergraduate, degree-seeking on-campus students only. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using the Elluminate Live! web conferencing software at a time arranged by the instructor. This section has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees. Please email Tina Knox at tmknox@illinois.edu for approval to register for this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Biology or Biochemistry or Molecular and Cellular Biology major(s).
